title: Find cheats with values to choose
changes: Add a values-to-choose filter for entries with at least one assessed, valid parameter declaration. Preserve the existing candidate, region and armed filters and do not select parameter values implicitly.
Keep the filter independent of ROM compatibility or execution: source selection, explicit values, checksums, preview and runtime guards remain required. Add English and Italian labels.
validation: Focused Linux selector and source-assessment tests passed, including different ROM contexts, a mixed fixed/parameterized source and an invalid declaration. Windows GNU test binaries and frontend built. Initial Linux linking failed without a Wayland development link; a subsequent unit ran all four commands successfully but retained scratch because the temporary link was still present. A separate protected-input and log receipt verified their completion and unchanged source preimages: target/validation/units/dbg20-values-filter-build-receipt-_abfzj6t/; diagnostic units dbg20-values-filter-build-mkrwefap/ and dbg20-values-filter-build-9bwr44ef/.

The two affected Windows GNU tests passed under Wine, with unchanged test binaries verified by target/validation/units/dbg20-values-filter-wine-tests-receipt-kpd4ao71/. An initial GUI driver retained diagnostics after selecting the wrong filter; its Wine prefix drained.

A corrected isolated Wine/Xvfb GUI selected the new filter in a privately derived USA ability catalog, displayed eight parameterized entries and excluded the master, then explicitly opened a source and its value prompt. Screenshot reviewed; guest state and protected inputs unchanged, normal close and Wine drained. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-values-filter-wine-f820ejz6/.
limitations: The filter is a discovery aid, not proof of source compatibility, all valid values or device behavior. Character examples remain reference-only and CH-0236 stays excluded. Native Windows and physical controllers were not tested. Primary debugging model and reasoning effort could not be independently verified.
